Frequently Asked Questions

Is University of Punjab better than Habib University?

Both University of the Punjab and Habib University are HEC-recognized universities. University of Punjab is public (est. 1882) in Lahore / Gujranwala / Jhelum / Khanspur, while Habib University is private (est. 2014) in Karachi. The better choice depends on your field, budget, and merit — compare the details above.

What is the fee difference between University of Punjab and Habib University?

University of Punjab's fee is approximately Rs. 25–45K/sem per semester, while Habib University's is Rs. 9.8L–10.3L/sem. See the full comparison above.

What is the merit for University of Punjab and Habib University?

University of Punjab: ~75% Academic Record (Inter/Matric) + 25% PU Admission Test. Engineering: ECAT. Pharmacy/Medical: MDCAT.. Habib University: Habib Entrance Test + interview + academic record + meta-curricular profile. SAT accepted (exemptions). Accepts A-Levels, IB, FBISE, AKU-EB, equivalents..
